description: This file defines a React functional component called CallTab, which renders detailed information about a specific action trace event within a UI. It includes rendering properties such as time, parameters, and return values, and provides utility functions for formatting and displaying serialized values.

methods.name: renderDuration
methods.description: Returns a string representing the duration of an action, or 'Timed Out'/'Running' based on the action's endTime or error status.

methods.name: renderProperty
methods.description: Helper function that renders a property key-value pair with copy-to-clipboard functionality for specific property types.

methods.name: propertyToString
methods.description: Converts an event property to a displayable Property object, applying special formatting for certain property names and types.

methods.name: parseSerializedValue
methods.description: Parses a SerializedValue object into a JavaScript value, handling various serialized formats like numbers, strings, objects, handles, dates, regexes, etc.
